title: Favourite Books List
prompt: Create an ordered list of reading steps and an unordered list of at least two favourite books.
objective: Use both ol and ul and include li children for each item.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: ordered, unordered, and nested lists.
hints: The order of steps matters; the order of book titles does not. Choose ol and ul accordingly.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer:
My Favourite Books

Top three books

  1. The Hobbit
  2. Wonder
  3. Matilda

Books I Want to Read

  • A Wrinkle in Time
  • The Secret Garden
  • Charlotte's Web
solution.explanation: One complete example is shown above. Reference approach: The order of steps matters; the order of book titles does not. Choose ol and ul accordingly. Required structural evidence: <ol>, <ul>, <li>.
solution.expected_result: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: ordered, unordered, and nested lists.
